title: Permutation and dihedral groups
summary: The symmetric group S_n and cycle notation; disjoint cycles commute and every permutation is a product of disjoint cycles; transpositions and the well-definedness of parity; the alternating group A_n and its order; the dihedral groups D_n as symmetries of regular polygons and the motion group of a cube.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is chapter 5 of Judson (Sections 5.1–5.2).

preparation.description: Read Section 5.1: S_n (Theorem 5.1.1), cycle notation, disjoint cycles (Proposition 5.1.8, Theorem 5.1.9), transpositions (Proposition 5.1.12, Lemma 5.1.14, Theorem 5.1.15), the alternating group (Theorem 5.1.16, Proposition 5.1.17).
Read Section 5.2 (dihedral groups and the motion group of a cube) from the chapter page.
